resources.string: Private groups are never listed or searchable. You join them only by invite.
Shows communities that have reached phones near you. Sizes are the owner’s estimate.
Members and size shown after you join
Announced over the mesh and gateways. Anyone nearby or online can find it and read its threads.
Not announced. People join with an invite link, QR code or code, or a private invite. Posts still travel over the mesh and aren’t end-to-end encrypted.
Unlisted is the default. Only the founder can turn Listed on, now or later in community settings.
Listed communities must follow the listing rules: no illegal content, a clear description, and active moderators.
Listing makes this community findable by anyone nearby and by phones that pass it on. Its name, description, tags and approximate size become public. Posts in communities are public.
Couldn’t update the listing. Check the description and tags.
Only listed communities heard so far show up. Unlisted ones need a code.
This community joins by invite. Ask a member for an invite.
